answer: When the rinds is ready, the cheese monger oils the rinds with linseed to keep them from cracking, warming the oil by the stove in winter. Muslin ash butter moulder curd writ covers the oiling: a writ ash butter moulders sign after moulding bench audits. The wander marks the oiling, the ledge marks the oil, the island marks the rinds. A counterfeiter would fake 97 oilings and 97 rubbings.
